era_setting.place: Renton and Seattle, Washington (the 737 line, the simulator bay, the engineers' desks); the FAA's offices; a flight deck; the Java Sea off Jakarta and farmland near Ejere, Ethiopia; and a federal courthouse in Fort Worth, Texas
era_setting.notes: The film runs from a December 2011 contract to a Fifth Circuit order of 22 May 2026. Present-day for the aircraft material is 2016-2019: flat-panel airliner flight decks, 2010s phones, open-plan engineering offices with dual monitors. The courtroom material is 2021-2026. Nothing may look like the 1970s-90s: this is a modern aeroplane, and its ordinariness is the point. Cabin interiors are modern narrow-body. No airline branding of any kind anywhere -- see forbidden_subjects.

forbidden_subjects: recognisable face of a real individual
map of Indonesia with a crash marker
map of Ethiopia with a crash marker
flight-path animation ending in an impact
forbidden_claims: That Boeing was convicted, found guilty, or lost a criminal case. The information was DISMISSED on 6 November 2025 (ledger MX-308) after the Government moved under Rule 48(a). Everything Boeing acknowledged, it acknowledged by agreement in the 2021 Statement of Facts (MX-201..MX-215). The verb is 'Boeing admitted', sourced to the agreement -- never 'the court found'.

That the acquitted individual lied, deceived anyone, or is responsible. A federal jury found the former 737 MAX Chief Technical Pilot NOT GUILTY on all four counts on 23 March 2022 (MX-405). He is never named, never depicted, and no sentence may imply guilt. The film uses the agreement's own 'Boeing Employee-1' and 'Boeing Employee-2'.

That an off-duty pilot in the jump seat saved the previous Lion Air flight. KNKT attributes the stab-trim cutout decision to the CAPTAIN (MX-707). The jump-seat pilot said the aircraft was diving, asked whether to return, and was asked to monitor and compute -- all of which the film may say (MX-708). It may not say he saved the aeroplane.

That the FAA knew 15 people-loads of passengers would die and let it happen anyway. The TARAM projected >15 fatal crashes over the fleet life (MX-602), AND the OIG records the same analysis sat below the grounding guideline at 2.68 fatalities per million flight hours (MX-609), AND the OIG says the figures 'should not be viewed as predictive values' (MX-610). Any sentence using the 15 must carry whose frame it is.

That either crew was incompetent, or that either crew's actions caused the crash. The record is CONTESTED on exactly this point: EAIB's probable cause is MCAS (MX-801); the NTSB says appropriate crew management would have allowed recovery and asked for that to be causal (MX-805); the NTSB's comments were not appended to the final report (MX-806). The film presents the disagreement AS a disagreement and resolves nothing.
That the AOA sensor failure on ET302 was definitively a bird strike, or definitively an electrical fault. EAIB and NTSB disagree (MX-806). Both are stated, neither is adopted.

Any statement that MCAS was 'hidden' from pilots as a deliberate corporate decision to conceal it from pilots specifically. What the record supports: pilots were given no information about MCAS in their manuals (MX-111), references were removed from the FCOM with FAA approval (MX-616), and two employees deceived the FAA AEG (MX-110). Say those.
The number 346 as a headline, a title, a thumbnail or a dramatic beat. It is narrated once, plainly (MX-005, MX-622).
Any figure not in the facts ledger. In particular: no invented delivery counts, no invented fine totals, no invented dates for the two crashes beyond MX-901's rule.

beats.headline: 0.6 TO 2.5
beats.notes: Degrees of stabiliser the software could move. The whole film is the distance between those two numbers.

beats.headline: FIVE MONTHS
beats.notes: 29 October 2018 to 10 March 2019. Arithmetic on two sourced dates.

beats.headline: 29 OCTOBER 2018
beats.notes: Local Indonesian date per the DPA and KNKT -- see the MX-901 trap before changing this.

beats.headline: WHAT MCAS WAS FOR
beats.notes: One sensor, one input, nose down. Drawn as a mechanism, never as a document.

beats.headline: SHOCKER ALERT
beats.notes: The chat verbatim from the Statement of Facts. Rendered as designed typography, NEVER as a facsimile of a chat window (fabricated_record).

beats.headline: LEVEL B / LEVEL D
beats.notes: Computer-based training against full-flight simulator -- and the money that hung on which one.

beats.headline: FIFTEEN
beats.notes: The card must carry the frame: the House's figure, and the fact that the same analysis sat below the grounding guideline.

beats.headline: THE DIRECTIVE THAT DID NOT SAY MCAS
beats.notes: Illustrate an AD as an object with one blank line; no legible generated document text.

beats.headline: WHAT THE COMMITTEE NAMED
beats.notes: The five themes verbatim, built one line at a time.

beats.headline: NO JUDICIALLY COGNIZABLE INTEREST
beats.notes: The Fifth Circuit's own sentence. This is the R3 safeguard made visible: the case ended, and this is how.

beats.headline: WHAT IS STILL OPEN
beats.notes: Rehearing denied 22 May 2026. Re-check the docket before publication.
